mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity ELSE -ol.quantity END) AS netQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order ELSE -(ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order) END) AS netRevenue, CASE WHEN p.cost_price IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity ELSE -ol.quantity END) * (p.price - p.cost_price) END AS totalMargin FROM product p JOIN order_log ol ON ol.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost_price ORDER BY netRevenue DESC

SELECT FORMATDATETIME(ol.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS orderDate, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity ELSE -ol.quantity END) AS netQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order ELSE -(ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order) END) AS netRevenue FROM order_log ol GROUP BY FORMATDATETIME(ol.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY orderDate DESC

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, COALESCE(c.name, '미분류') AS categoryName, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order ELSE -(ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order) END) AS netRevenue FROM order_log ol JOIN product p ON p.id = ol.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY netRevenue DESC

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'CANCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalCancelCount, ROUND( CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'CANCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2 ) AS cancelRate FROM product p JOIN order_log ol ON ol.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY cancelRate DESC

SELECT s.id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, COALESCE(purchase.amount, 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount, COALESCE(sales.amount, 0) AS totalSalesAmount FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.supplier_id AS supplier_id, SUM(sh.amount * sh.unit_cost) AS amount FROM stock_history sh JOIN product p ON p.id = sh.product_id WHERE sh.reason = 'PURCHASE_IN' AND sh.unit_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.supplier_id ) purchase ON purchase.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.supplier_id AS supplier_id, SUM(CASE WHEN ol.type = 'ORDER' THEN ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order ELSE -(ol.quantity * ol.price_at_order) END) AS amount FROM order_log ol JOIN product p ON p.id = ol.product_id GROUP BY p.supplier_id ) sales ON sales.supplier_id = s.id ORDER BY totalSalesAmount DESC
